---
title: "Kid-led vs. Adult-led Episodes"
subtitle: "WHICH GROUP SPEAKS MORE?"
format: html
---

This comparison defines an episode by recorded dialogue: it is kid-led when Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Kenny have more transcript lines than Randy, Mr. Garrison, Chef, Gerald, Sharon, and Mr. Mackey. It is adult-led when the selected adults have more lines.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(southparkr)
library(plotly)

core_boys <- c("Stan", "Kyle", "Cartman", "Kenny")
selected_adults <- c("Randy", "Mr. Garrison", "Chef", "Gerald", "Sharon", "Mr. Mackey")

dialogue_lines <- episode_lines |>
  mutate(character = str_remove_all(character, "[:\"]"))

episode_catalog <- dialogue_lines |>
  distinct(season_number, season_episode_number, episode_name)

episode_cast_counts <- dialogue_lines |>
  filter(character %in% c(core_boys, selected_adults)) |>
  mutate(cast = if_else(character %in% core_boys, "kids", "adults")) |>
  count(season_number, season_episode_number, episode_name, cast, name = "lines") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cast, values_from = lines, values_fill = 0)

episode_leadership <- episode_catalog |>
  left_join(
    episode_cast_counts,
    by = c("season_number", "season_episode_number", "episode_name")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(kids, adults), \(x) replace_na(x, 0L)),
    leadership = case_when(
      adults > kids ~ "Adult-led",
      kids > adults ~ "Kid-led",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  )

period_summary <- episode_leadership |>
  mutate(period = case_when(
    season_number <= 7 ~ "Early (seasons 1-7)",
    season_number >= 15 ~ "Late (seasons 15-21)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) |>
  filter(!is.na(period)) |>
  count(period, leadership, name = "episodes") |>
  complete(
    period = c("Early (seasons 1-7)", "Late (seasons 15-21)"),
    leadership = c("Kid-led", "Adult-led", "Tie"),
    fill = list(episodes = 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  mutate(share = 100 * episodes / sum(episodes)) |>
  ungroup()

leadership_plot <- period_summary |>
  mutate(leadership = factor(leadership, levels = c("Kid-led", "Adult-led", "Tie"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = period,
    y = share,
    fill = leadership,
    text = paste(
      "Period:", period,
      "<br>Episode type:", leadership,
      "<br>Episodes:", episodes,
      "<br>Share:", round(share, 1), "%"
    )
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Kid-led" = "#005A9C", "Adult-led" = "#A33A13", "Tie" = "#4F5B5E")) +
  labs(
    title = "Episode leadership in early and late seasons",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of episodes",
    fill = "Dialogue leader",
    caption = "Source: southparkr transcript data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(leadership_plot, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
leadership_table <- period_summary |>
  select(period, leadership, episodes, share) |>
  mutate(share = round(share, 1)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = leadership,
    values_from = c(episodes, share)
  )

knitr::kable(
  leadership_table,
  caption = "Episode leadership counts and shares"
)
```

For the period comparison, seasons 1-7 are grouped as early and seasons 15-21 as late; seasons 8-14 are excluded. These labels describe recorded dialogue, not an episode's plot or official characterization.
